- cols 34-36: ggg (gray) - top-right

So the pattern is:
- Click 1st cell (white) → turns green
- Click 2nd cell (white) → turns green
- Click 3rd cell (any) → clears everything to gray
So the limit is 2 green cells? That doesn't match the purple pattern which has 4 dots...
Wait, maybe I need to look at this differently. Maybe the game isn't about making cells green. Maybe it's about something else entirely.

Actually, let me look at the top bar more carefully. It has blue and sky blue sections. Maybe these are color selectors or progress indicators.

- Middle-left

- Bottom-center

But the issue is that clicking more than 2 cells clears everything. So maybe I need to click them in a different order, or there's some other mechanic I'm missing.
